results.title: After the 1.3 production deploy the pools written match the review list

steps.title: Given release 1.3 is deployed in production and the super admin is on Administration > Organizations
When the super admin reads the Prompts column of the sampled organisations
Then each pool equals the computed pool of the review list
And the organisations full on day one show as full, not red
And an organisation with no prompt shows its full pool
And no organisation shows "—" or a red value

results.notes: Prod back office, Organisations tab, 91 live organisations (5 pages of 20, all walked through the UI). Sampled: Nabep 105 / 105, Roche Italia 70 / 70 (full, default slate colour), Trial - Great Eastern 113 / 140, Onclusive - TechOps 0 / 1600, QA-GEO 259 / 24400 = computed pools. Full comparison by organisation_id (GET /geo/api/v1/admin/organisations, read only): vs the 21/10 review list (84 orgs) 83 match, 1 differs: Trial - KitchenAid 420 vs 280 (quota edited in 1.2 after 21/10; the 28/10 prod review list attached to GEO-1515 already gives 420). vs the 28/10 prod review list (91 orgs): 91 / 91 match. The 7 organisations not in the 21/10 list were created after it (Luther Pendragon, (Trial) - EIB, BDR - Custom demo, Maribank, REPRESENTACIONES DE ESPACIO VIRTUAL, (Trial) Once, Trial - MB92). No "—", no null pool, no organisation above its pool, one single text colour on the whole Prompts column. Nothing changed.
